final_answer:
The current CEO of Apple is Timothy Donald Cook.

Tim Cook has an educational background in business administration and computer science. He graduated from Auburn University with a Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, and later earned a Master's degree in Business Administration from Duke University's Fuqua School of Business.

Apple was founded on April 1, 1976.
